messages:
oliver: Release train bulletin: placing a temporary 48h freeze to roll a critical kernel + NIC firmware fix after we saw intermittent packet-drop related P99 spikes on model-router during high-concurrency embedding workloads. Please hold all non-essential merges and deploys until we validate.

mei: Which clusters are in scope and what's the observed symptom set?

oliver: Scope: a subset of us-west GPU racks and the model-router frontends attached to them. Symptoms: short-lived P99 latency bursts (~200-400ms), occasional connection resets to a small fraction of upstream model shards under very high QPS. Not a global outage but risky for new rollouts.

david: Canary data: canary-x had 2 spike events in the last 3 hours, coincident with slightly elevated network retransmits. I paused canary promotions.

release-bot: canary-x promotions PAUSED by david at 2026-06-11T10:03Z.

carla: Ops plan: we'll apply NIC firmware + kernel netstack patch to one canary rack, run a 60m soak with synthetic high-concurrency embed traffic, and compare retransmit and p99 deltas. If green, stagger across racks with 30m windows.

ops-oncall: Starting patch on rack-7 (canary) now. Will post validation checklist output and dashboard snapshots after the 60m soak.

oliver: Exception flow for urgent business-critical fixes during freeze:
```
/permit-deploy RELEASE-CRITICAL --pr <URL> --reason "urgent: connection resets causing user-visible latency" --approvers @eng-sre @release-mgr
```
Must include rollback steps, smoke tests, and a brief risk statement.

mei: Mitigations while we patch: 1) soft-throttle embeddings (/v1/embed) for canary-x to 30 rps, 2) temporarily disable cross-shard fanout for heavy clients, 3) increase the client-side connection pool timeout to 90s for retries.

david: Also recommend lowering max concurrent model requests from some heavy clients by 20% until full-roll completes.

ops-oncall: First canary rack patched. Beginning 60m soak. Initial metrics: retransmits down ~35%, P99 reduced ~120ms on patched nodes, no connection resets observed in the last 10m. Will continue to monitor.

carla: Good sign. Proceed with staggered roll if the 60m window remains green. After full-roll, require 2h of post-roll stability (p99 and retransmits within baseline) before re-enabling promotions.

mei: How will we lift the freeze? Do we auto-unfreeze?

oliver: Auto-unfreeze disabled. I'll manually lift when ops reports full-roll complete + stability window passed. Update calendar: freeze extended 48h, tentative unfreeze Thu 15:00 UTC (manual gate).

release-bot: Freeze applied by oliver. Auto-unfreeze OFF. Tentative unfreeze: 2026-06-13T15:00Z.

ops-oncall: 60m soak complete: no further spikes, retransmits remain low, and CPU/network metrics stable. Rolling to remaining racks with 30m staggers now. Posting perf snapshots to the ops dashboard.

david: After first two racks patched, running canary promotion smoke tests now. If green, continue.

carla: Reminder for teams: if you submitted a PR that's now blocked by the freeze and you need a business-critical rollout, follow the /permit-deploy flow and ping me + eng-sre. We'll triage fast.

oliver: Thanks all. Please escalate regressions in this thread and add a 2-line summary to the postmortem doc after rollout completes. I'll post final lift notice here once the stability window clears.
